definitions.explanation: The process by which rural areas become more developed and populated, taking on urban characteristics.

examples.japanese: {都市化|としか}が{急速|きゅうそく}に{進|すす}んでいる。
{都市化|としか}の{影響|えいきょう}で{自然|しぜん}が{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: Nature is decreasing due to urbanization.

examples.japanese: {都市化|としか}は{世界的|せかいてき}な{傾向|けいこう}だ。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市化|としか}が{進|すす}む: urbanization advances
- {都市化|としか}の{影響|えいきょう}: effects of urbanization
- {急速|きゅうそく}な{都市化|としか}: rapid urbanization
- {都市化|としか}{現象|げんしょう}: urbanization phenomenon

RELATED TERMS:
- {工業化|こうぎょうか}: industrialization
- {近代化|きんだいか}: modernization
- {過疎化|かそか}: depopulation (of rural areas)
